title: The Limits of Agreement — The Foot of Mount Phyle
description: The Fischer, Lynch and Paterson impossibility result: four mercenaries, their ravens, and why no plan can promise that anyone ever commits.
question: Can machines always agree when one of them may stop silently and messages take any time at all?
how: We find out by exploring how four mercenaries at the foot of a hill, unable to see one another, tried to agree whether to attack or hold when any of them might be dead.

papers.authors: Michael J. Fischer, Nancy A. Lynch and Michael S. Paterson
papers.title: Impossibility of Distributed Consensus with One Faulty Process
